Callout.Name: Asthma Attack
Callout.Message: Person unable to breathe properly, inhaler not working.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, sitting, speaking in short sentences.

Script.Line: It came on about an hour ago and the blue one is empty.
I cannot finish a sentence. I know what that means.
Sit me up. Do not lay me down.

Callout.Patient: I can get air in. It is the getting it out that I cannot do.

Lines.Approach: She is sat on the step and cannot get a full sentence out. The inhaler is empty.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
